timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,500 KRW/USD (currently holding in the 1500s)

WHY: The news indicates the won is currently weak (1500 KRW per USD), making dollars expensive to buy right now. However, multiple sources forecast the won will strengthen to ~1,450 KRW/USD in the second half of 2026 due to US-Iran agreement and reduced Middle East tensions, meaning you would get better rates soon.

TIP: Consider delaying or reducing this month's conversion if possible, since the won is expected to strengthen (lower KRW per USD) within weeks to months, which would make your $2,000 purchase cheaper.
